title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Notice Amount and the Per-Container Cap
content:
The amount written on a notice of loss under `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` is the container value, held within the tier's per-container cover cap where the tier has one.

## Statement

- Where the tier's cover cap per container is above 0.00 and the container value is higher than that cap, the notice carries the cap.
- In every other case the notice carries the container value.
- The amount carried is rounded to the cent.

A tier whose per-container cover cap is 0.00 applies no cap to the notice amount.

## Truth table (hypothetical figures)

| Tier's cover cap per container (USD) | Container value (USD) | Amount on the notice (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| 0.00 | 83333.33 | 83333.33 |
| 60000.00 | 83333.33 | 60000.00 |
| 60000.00 | 60000.00 | 60000.00 |
| 60000.00 | 22500.00 | 22500.00 |

The amount so fixed is the value exposed in the named container. It is a figure for the notice and says nothing yet about the loss that will prove to have been suffered.
